description_en: Runs an SDXL inpainting workflow with InstantID support—from preparation through the 1st pass and identity stage to the final 2nd pass.

cmkHighlight_en: InstantID is integrated into the active SDXL process and provides identity guidance between the 1st and 2nd passes.
